prompt.en: In a federal election, what are Canadians choosing?
prompt.fr: À une élection fédérale, que choisissent les Canadiens?

options.en: The people who will speak for them in the House of Commons.
options.fr: Les personnes qui parleront en leur nom à la Chambre des communes.

options.en: The Prime Minister, directly by name.
options.fr: Le premier ministre, directement par son nom.

explanation.en: A federal election fills the seats in the House of Commons. Voters choose the members who will speak for them there.
explanation.fr: Une élection fédérale sert à pourvoir les sièges de la Chambre des communes. Les électeurs choisissent les députés qui parleront en leur nom.

source.quote: Canadians vote in elections for the people they want to represent them in the House of Commons.

verification.evidence: Canadians vote in elections for the people they want to represent them in the House of Commons. In each election, voters may re-elect the same members of the House of Commons or choose new ones. Members of the House of Commons are also known as members of Parliament or MPs.
